pipeline.title: FDA clears ImmunityBio’s Anktiva expansion in bladder cancer after regulatory whiplash
pipeline.summary: To expand Anktiva’s label, the FDA adopted a new approach to how it evaluates treatments for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC. The new regulatory path essentially allowed ImmunityBio to bypass an expensive randomized phase 3 trial that competitor Johnson & Johnson is currently forced t

pipeline.title: EyePoint cuts headcount, shifts priorities after another Duravyu AMD miss
pipeline.summary: In new topline results, EyePoint disclosed that its tyrosine kinase inhibitor Duravyu performed worse than Eylea in patients with wet AMD, compelling the pharma to drop its program in the indication and make significant staff cuts.

pipeline.title: Lilly partners with Hong Kong's Metis in $1.1B deal to bolster AI nanoparticle discovery
pipeline.summary: The collaboration is another in a series of partnerships Lilly has accumulated in both drug delivery and AI-based technologies.

pipeline.title: Investment firm TCGX picks migraine biotech TriGemX to take public via SPAC
pipeline.summary: Life sciences-focused investment firm TCGX will use a special purpose acquisition company to take migraine-minded TriGemX Bio public.

pipeline.title: Novartis pauses midstage Fabhalta trial in lupus nephritis—but efficacy, safety not at play
pipeline.summary: Amid a steady advance of kidney-focused label expansions, Novartis’ Fabhalta is slowing its roll in a key potential autoimmune niche.

pipeline.title: Roche pauses future Germany investments, joining growing chorus of pharma pullbacks
pipeline.summary: Amid tensions over government healthcare cost-cutting policies, Roche has slammed the brakes on new investments in Germany, joining an expanding group of drugmakers pulling back from the European country.

pipeline.title: Enlivex lays off 60% of employees, scraps preclinical R&D and gives execs ‘substantial’ salary cuts
pipeline.summary: Enlivex is laying off 60% of its workforce, ending preclinical R&D and trimming its top execs’ salaries as the Israeli biotech tries to keep cash flowing to its osteoarthritis drug.

pipeline.title: Roche inks $15B ADC pact with Hansoh; Veradermics scores in another baldness study
pipeline.summary: Roche is paying Hansoh $400 million up front in a broad deal involving several ADCs. Elsewhere, another top investor formed a China-focused fund and Ultragenyx sold a second review voucher.

pipeline.title: Roche returns to China’s ADC powerhouse Hansoh for $15B biobucks pact
pipeline.summary: A year after their first antibody-drug conjugate team-up, Roche has returned to Hansoh Pharmaceutical for a mammoth $15 billion biobucks pact.

pipeline.title: From strategy to scale: How Saudi Arabia is building a biotech ecosystem
pipeline.summary: Saudi Arabia’s biotech strategy now has named partners, sites and capital behind it.

pipeline.title: Extractables in single-use systems used in ADC manufacturing
pipeline.summary: Explore extractables data supporting single-use systems in ADC manufacturing.

pipeline.title: How early should you engage a CDMO?
pipeline.summary: Discover which CMC activities can move forward early, and which decisions need to remain flexible.

pipeline.title: Siemens Healthineers partners with Paradromics to build out new imaging system to support BCIs
pipeline.summary: Paradromics has announced a new collaboration with Siemens Healthineers to construct an advanced multimodal imaging platform to support the growing clinical use of implantable brain-computer interfaces (BCIs).

pipeline.title: Labcorp pays $722M in upfront cash deal for BioReference Health assets
pipeline.summary: Labcorp and OPKO Health have partnered up for an agreement that sees Labcorp to acquire select assets of BioReference Health, a subsidiary of OPKO.

pipeline.title: GSK taps actress Viola Davis for shingles-focused campaign
pipeline.summary: The "How to Get Away With Murder" star is the face of GSK's "Shingles, actually" campaign, which positions an increased shingles risk as an untold reality of aging.

pipeline.title: Iambic CEO on taking an AI drug company public
pipeline.summary: Fresh off a $150 million IPO, Tom Miller spoke to BioPharma Dive about the roadshow process and how he sees AI’s role in drug development evolving.

pipeline.title: Sanofi cycles deeper into sports marketing niche as Tour de France partner
pipeline.summary: The French pharma will sponsor the prestigious white jersey, awarded to the best rider under 25, at both the Tour de France and the Tour de France Femmes in 2027.

pipeline.title: Lilly's obesity pill, RevMed's pancreatic cancer breakthrough among slew of CHMP endorsements in Europe
pipeline.summary: Across the pond, European regulators handed down a pair of pivotal approval recommendations this week, making way for a new front in Novo and Eli Lilly’s oral GLP-1 showdown and endorsing Revolution Medicines’ potential pancreatic cancer game changer.

pipeline.title: China looks to ban foreign acquisitions of critical biopharma platforms
pipeline.summary: As Washington ramps up efforts to tighten cross-border life sciences deals involving Chinese assets, Beijing is moving to tighten its own grip on biomedical innovation, rolling out a draft policy that would ban or restrict the export of key biopharmaceutical technologies.

pipeline.title: Ambrose Healthcare inks $181M deal for former Pfizer target AM-Pharma
pipeline.summary: Ambrose Healthcare has bought AM-Pharma for up to 161 million euros, inking a cut-price deal for a biotech once courted by Pfizer.

pipeline.title: Inside Teva's Weltruza launch and Novo's GLP-1 strategy
pipeline.summary: This week on "The Top Line," we catch up with leaders from Teva and Novo to discuss new drug launches, growth opportunities and what's ahead for both companies.

pipeline.title: Roche makes class-first push into thyroid eye disease with new FDA nod for Enspryng
pipeline.summary: Some six years after scoring an initial FDA nod, Roche’s IL-6 receptor inhibitor Enspryng is muscling up to Amgen's Tepezza in a key eye disease arena.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: Moderna’s massive stock run
pipeline.summary: The latest installment in BioPharma Dive’s data visualization-focused series includes a look at Moderna’s meteoric rise in 2026 and a sudden deal surge from Roche.

pipeline.title: Next-gen RNAi drugmaker City prices $200M IPO
pipeline.summary: The offering will support a trio of medicines in or nearing clinical testing, as well as earlier research into RNAi treatments that get into tissues outside the liver.

pipeline.title: Biogen-backed Estuary nabs $93M for kidney disease gene therapy
pipeline.summary: The Series A round, which was led by RA Capital, will help fund the development of two genetic medicines designed to treat an inherited kidney disorder known as "ADPKD."

pipeline.title: Labcorp, Thrive Global launch latest Thrive 5 health test
pipeline.summary: Labcorp has launched the Thrive 5 Health Test that is now offered through a collaboration with Arianna Huffington's behavior change technology company, Thrive Global.

pipeline.title: FDA issues early alert for Edwards Lifesciences’ mitral valve delivery system after reported death, injury
pipeline.summary: The FDA has issued an early alert for certain delivery systems used with Edwards Lifesciences’ SAPIEN M3 transcatheter mitral valve replacement system amid serious safety concerns.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Roche’s $1.2B obesity deal; Asahi Kasei’s FDA nod; Verastem’s KRAS boon
pipeline.summary: Roche extended its China shopping spree with a $1 billion-plus obesity deal. Asahi Kasei's Hovilpri became the first HSV drug with a novel mechanism approved in nearly 30 years. Verastem's China-licensed KRAS G12D inhibitor showed strong early data in pancreatic cancer. And more.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Bausch + Lomb's returning CEO Saunders exits again
pipeline.summary: Bausch + Lomb CEO Brent Saunders is making a second exit from the eye health company, as the president of parent Bausch Health steps in temporarily. Plus, Paragon Labs is buying out  Apogee talent after its acquisition by AbbVie.

pipeline.title: Aligning drug discovery around patient benefit from the outset: Connecting human insights to better decisions
pipeline.summary: The pharmaceutical industry has traditionally viewed drug discovery and clinical development as separate stages of the R&D continuum.

pipeline.title: Kindeva lands $226M defense contract to supply nerve agent antidote in US
pipeline.summary: Kindeva's Meridian was awarded a $226 million defense contract to supply the U.S. military with its self-injected nerve agent antidote and bolster national defense against chemical threats.

pipeline.title: With new Omvoh analyses, Lilly argues 'higher bar' for IBD treatment is within reach

pipeline.title: Par Health recalls 22 lots of IV blood thinner, its 3rd US product pull in a month
pipeline.summary: Par Health issued a recall of 22 lots of the intravenous anticoagulant argatroban, the latest in a string of recent recalls related to IV-bag contamination risk.

pipeline.title: Isotope supplier NorthStar continues rise with partnership to tee up China radiopharmaceutical filings
pipeline.summary: As the momentum continues to pick up at NorthStar Medical Technologies, the radioisotope producer is strengthening ties in China, in a move that helps put its actinium-225 supplies on the map for local radiopharmaceutical filings.

pipeline.title: Compass puts treatment-resistant depression on the map with first awareness day
pipeline.summary: Compass Pathways has partnered with mental health organizations on the first-ever awareness day for treatment-resistant depression.

pipeline.title: Gilead puts a timely spotlight on HIV prevention in Latino communities with 'Ahorita Mismo' campaign
pipeline.summary: Gilead's “Ahorita Mismo (Right Now!)” stars two popular Latino creators in a call-in podcast-themed spot looking to spark conversations around HIV prevention.

pipeline.title: Immune Boost Capital Invests in Orthrus Therapeutics to Advance Antigen-Specific Immune Tolerance for Autoimmune Disease

pipeline.title: From Scientific Hypothesis to Clinical Practice: The Next Chapter for CLDN18.2
pipeline.summary: Astellas reflects on a decade of progress in CLDN18.2 and the opportunities ahead in patient identification, testing and innovation

pipeline.title: Saudi Arabia takes actionable steps to build its biotech sector after 46 agreements in Riyadh
pipeline.summary: Riyadh’s biotech summit closed with 46 agreements. Its chairman explains how Saudi Arabia plans to turn them into working programs.

pipeline.title: Drugmakers, PhRMA seek to intervene in hospitals' 340B rebate challenge
pipeline.summary: The American Hospital Association and others have launched a legal rematch with the federal government over the second iteration of a pilot program swapping out safety-net hospitals’ upfront drug discounts for after-the-fact rebates.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo, Wegovy pill undergo minor fluctuations
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Enlivex excises 60%; Eyepoint halves headcount
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.
